scope: I04 extensive but bounded RSI14-only standalone entry/exit study. No ladder, live changes, indicator mixtures, HL or SR.

entryRules.into: Contrarian: long previous RSI > L and current <= L; short previous < U and current >= U; L=100-U.
entryRules.back_out: Recovery: long previous <= L and current > L; short previous >= U and current < U.
entryRules.rsi_center: Trend interpretation: long previous <=50 and current >50; short previous >=50 and current <50. Fixed12h only; not an overbought fade.
entryRules.clock: Retain I01 rolling12h controls unchanged, one per side/window/delay, not duplicated per timeframe.

formula: Unrounded Wilder RSI14, 14 close differences simple-mean seed then 1/14 recursion. First valid at 15 closes. Flat=50; gains-only=100; losses-only=0. Same research feature version as I01.
exitRules: Timeout12h from actual fill; indicator_or12h also exits at first subsequent completed selected-timeframe RSI >=50 long / <=50 short, strictly after entry. Timeout takes priority. A pending exit is never replaced.
timing: Fixed June1 seed; fully completed contiguous UTC bars. Signal at bar end, execution subsequent minute open with modeled0 publication lag, or +1m delay to every market action. No use of current execution minute H/L/C; no reseed, start-state synthetic crossing or forming bars.
inventory: One position per independent rule, no adds or compounding. Ignore occupied/pending signals, require fresh crossings after exit. Close then entry sequencing. Mark cutoff inventory with hypothetical exit fee, not artificial completed trade.
funding: Excluded; settlement archive incomplete after April2026. No live/margin/liquidation/queue-fill certification. No market or API actions.
researchScreen: Inherited I01 strict diagnostic: >=30 full/10 recent closes, positive net and positive same-side clock delta in all four cases, no monthly marked regression, positive extra5bps/side cost stress, no equity exhaustion. Preserve failures, including sparse/zero signals. Not a proof of family uselessness or a deployment gate.
ranking: Descending full zero-delay net delta versus same-side clock for all210; additionally show side-specific absolute-net ranks and a predeclared eligible shortlist: >=30full/10recent in both delays AND positive net/stress in allfour. Rank that subset by full zero-delay net, retain monthly/clock failures. Select top5 by this subset if nonempty, otherwise top5 by full delta with sample limits explicit.
exitComparison: Every neutral50 exit is compared to its same timeframe/level/mode/side fixed12h companion, plus side clock. Both are independent full-path reruns.
reporting: Exact dates, baseline W/L counts and dollars, marked open/net/DD, both execution delays, cost sensitivity, monthly deltas top5, event scarcity by timeframe/threshold, worst trade paths and concentration for shortlist. Document descriptive later-combination angles without running combinations.
overlapParity: Four prior RSI1h U70 back_out side/exit rules plus two clocks, all four window/delay cases. Compare engine ledgers/months/stats against unchanged I01 engine AND saved verified artifacts before any new outcomes.
selectionLimit: 210 correlated definitions, 206 new. All windows already mined and overlapping; no independent holdout, p-value or optimized-live claim. Period14 fixed; no period sweep, daily RSI, divergence, duration/persistence, trailing/SL/TP grid or combinations. No post-result expansion.
